text:
The Meridian plan (3–10 Nov) covers six modules: quota, profile, archive, indexer, catalog, and search. Profile must roll out before catalog. Search depends on profile, and the indexer depends on quota but must not depend on archive, directly or indirectly. Events.py and paths.py belong to profile, and worker alpha owns catalog. Profile and search run on different workers, while profile and archive share one.

Client-set values are catalog retry_limit = 9, search queue_depth = 350, and search timeout_s = 50 (corrected from 55).

Two coupling rules apply. If catalog retry_limit exceeds 8, quota max_workers must be 4 or fewer. If archive queue_depth exceeds 230, indexer ttl_s must be 60 or less. Archive's queue_depth is 260, so the second rule applies.

Other decisions: code review turnaround stays under one day, budget review moves to next Thursday, Ravi is checking whether the legacy exporter can be retired, archive gets a design review after launch, and there is no quota rewrite in Rust this quarter.
